services.name: functions
services.purpose: Host attendance-api Azure Functions v4 (HTTP triggers). Node 20, TypeScript.

services.name: staticWebApp
services.purpose: Host attendance-web React SPA (static Vite build). Free tier CDN.

services.name: storageAccount
services.purpose: AzureWebJobsStorage for the Functions host plus the Flex Consumption deployment package.

services.name: postgresFlexibleServer
services.purpose: Application relational DB (policies, attendance entries, future plans).

services.name: keyVault
services.purpose: Store the DB admin password and the Entra ID client secret. Function App reads via managed identity.

services.name: userAssignedIdentity
services.purpose: Managed identity for the Function App to access Storage, Key Vault, and Postgres without secrets.

services.name: logAnalyticsWorkspace
services.purpose: Backing workspace for Application Insights and platform diagnostics.

services.name: applicationInsights
services.purpose: APM + telemetry for the Function App.

breakdown.note: First 100k executions + 100k GB-seconds free monthly grant; this workload stays within the grant.
Free tier: 100 GB bandwidth/mo, 2 custom domains, SSL included.
Included storage + free backup up to server size.
$0.03 per 10k operations; a handful of secret reads/mo.
First 5 GB/mo ingestion free; small overage.

costEstimate.disclaimer: Estimates based on public Azure retail pricing for westus2 at plan time. Actual cost varies with traffic and storage growth. Review https://azure.microsoft.com/pricing/calculator for authoritative numbers.

rejectedAlternatives.reason: The API is an Azure Functions v4 project — Functions Flex Consumption is the native, cheaper (scale-to-zero) fit.
The schema uses PostgreSQL-specific types (uuid, timestamptz); migrating dialects would violate deploy-as-is.
Compliance queries need relational aggregates over date ranges; NoSQL rework rejected.
No Dockerfile present; the app builds to the Functions runtime, so container hosting adds cost with no benefit.

assumptions: PostgreSQL admin password will be auto-generated at deploy time and stored in Key Vault (never surfaced to the user).
Microsoft Entra ID app registration already exists; its client ID and tenant ID are supplied as deployment variables and the client secret is stored in Key Vault.
Static Web App is provisioned separately from Functions (BYO backend model) with CORS on the Function App locked to the SWA hostname.
Region westus2 chosen for combined Postgres Flexible Server + Functions Flex Consumption availability; fallback to westus3 if quota healing is needed.

postDeployRecommendations.title: Enable Application Insights availability tests against /api/health
Extend PostgreSQL PITR retention and enable geo-redundant backup
postDeployRecommendations.reason: Default 7-day PITR is thin for attendance history that must be retained.

postDeployRecommendations.title: Move Postgres to VNet + private endpoint
postDeployRecommendations.reason: Public network access with firewall is convenient but not defense-in-depth.

instrumentation.reason: The Function App will be provisioned with APPLICATIONINSIGHTS_CONNECTION_STRING wired to the shared workspace-based Application Insights resource.

deployStrategy.reason: Azure Functions Flex Consumption uses zip deploy with remote build. tsc runs via the Functions build pipeline; no native modules.
